newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar falls below 116 yen, then off lows.
newsitem.headline: Dollar falls below 116 yen, then off lows.

text.p: *Dollar dipped below 116 yen in the morning Tokyo on Thursday, its lowest level since January 13, dealers said.
*One dealer said it sank as low as 115.85 yen on slew of stop-loss dollar sales, with no major bids detected.
*Dollar then firmed back to 116 yen, but remained vulnerable to further falls to 115.00 yen in near term.
*Huge stop-loss sales expected at 113 yen, one dealer said.
*Dealers said selling by trust banks and U.S. funds detected, with stop-loss dollar sales initially triggered at 116.50 yen, dealers said.
